correctness.rationale: Reconstructed the exact channel identity using J1=sqrt(a) S_+ + mu sqrt(b) P0, J2=sqrt(b(1-mu^2))P0, J3=sqrt(b) S_-: sum J†J=(a+b)I and Phi_h=I+hL. Diagonal birth-death recurrence with summability forces d_n=(1-q)q^n, q=a/b<1. For each offset r>=1, roots 1,q and positivity c_n^(r)->0 force c_n^(r)=B_r q^n, while the ground boundary recursively fixes B_r=(1-q)(mu sqrt(q))^r. The Poisson-kernel mixture yields a positive trace-class state for 0<=mu<1, with pure projector at mu=1. Absolute HS summation yields purity ((1-q)/(1+q))((1+q mu^2)/(1-q mu^2)). Bounded GKSL uniformization and telescoped Euler remainder prove the stated uniform 1->1 bound, without claiming mixing. Independent finite-section construction at q=.4, mu=.7, N=26 gave maximum interior generator residual 5.56e-17, positive semidefinite truncation, plus exact rational 21/31 purity at q=2/5,mu=3/4. Finite checks do not establish the infinite proof.
